history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A duo-tone, dark, moody, and slightly desaturated portrait of a young East Asian person, split vertically into two identical halves. The subject has dark, messy hair and is wearing a white short-sleeved collared shirt over a black t-shirt. A patch with the word "KEANO" is visible on the left chest of the white shirt. On the right side of the shirt, another patch with a crest-like emblem and some text is present, along with a red and white stripe detail. The subject is looking directly at the camera with their tongue sticking out and making a peace sign with their right hand, which has a ring on the middle finger. The background is a textured, dark, greyish wall, creating a gritty and somewhat claustrophobic atmosphere. The lighting is dim and dramatic, casting subtle shadows and highlighting the subject's features. The overall mood is edgy, rebellious, and slightly provocative, with a strong emphasis on the subject's direct gaze and gesture. The color palette is dominated by muted blues, greys, and blacks, with the white shirt providing a stark contrast.
